products.name: Specialty Property and Casualty Insurance
products.description: A broad range of commercial insurance coverages focused on specialty and niche markets, including property, casualty, and financial lines, delivered through 36 autonomous insurance businesses under the Great American Insurance Group. Products are underwritten, serviced, and managed by specialized teams and distributed primarily via independent agents and brokers.

products.name: Agricultural Insurance
products.description: Federally reinsured multi-peril crop insurance and related agricultural coverages (crop-hail, equine mortality, etc.) for farms, ranches, and agribusinesses, delivered nationwide and involving both government and private reinsurance programs.

products.name: Transportation Insurance
products.description: Insurance products for vehicles and businesses in the transportation sector, including coverage for buses, trucks, moving and storage, and specialized physical damage products, often involving alternative risk transfer programs and risk sharing.

products.name: Property, Inland Marine, and Ocean Marine Insurance
products.description: Insurance for commercial properties, builders’ risk, contractors’ equipment, motor truck cargo, marine cargo, boat dealers, marina operators, and excursion vessels, requiring specialized underwriting and claims expertise.

products.name: Excess and Surplus Lines Insurance
products.description: Liability, umbrella, and excess coverage for unique, volatile, or hard-to-place risks, using non-standard rates and forms that generally do not require state regulatory approval.

products.name: Executive and Professional Liability Insurance
products.description: Insurance for directors and officers of businesses and non-profits, as well as errors and omissions coverage, requiring specialized underwriting and claims handling.

products.name: General Liability Insurance
products.description: Coverage for contractor-related businesses, energy development and production, mergers and acquisitions liability, and environmental liability risks, tailored to specific industries and exposures.

products.name: Targeted Markets Insurance
products.description: Customized liability and property insurance solutions for social service agencies, leisure, entertainment, non-profits, cyber risks, and other targeted markets, often involving alternative risk programs and agency captives.

products.name: Umbrella and Excess Liability Insurance
products.description: Insurance providing coverage in excess of primary liability layers, often for large commercial clients requiring higher limits.

products.name: Workers’ Compensation Insurance
products.description: Insurance covering prescribed benefits payable to employees injured on the job, including specialty loss prevention and higher retention options for certain accounts.

products.name: Fidelity and Surety Insurance
products.description: Fidelity and crime coverage for government, mercantile, and financial institutions, and surety bonds for contractors and corporations, requiring specialized underwriting and claims management.

products.name: Lender Services Insurance
products.description: Insurance risk management programs for lending and leasing institutions, including equipment leasing, collateral, and lender-placed mortgage property insurance, delivered through specialized teams and systems.

products.name: Trade Credit Insurance
products.description: Export and domestic trade credit insurance products for global trade and related financing activities, protecting businesses against non-payment risks.

products.name: Low Global Warming Potential (LGWP) Refrigerants
products.description: Manufactured LGWP refrigerants, including hydrofluoroolefins (HFOs) and HFO blends, for stationary (HVAC/R, commercial, industrial, residential) and automotive applications. Produced at scale using proprietary chemical synthesis and distributed globally to OEMs and aftermarket channels.

products.name: Blowing Agents
products.description: Manufactures LGWP blowing agents, primarily fluorine-based, used in insulating foam for building and appliance insulation. Produced via chemical processes and sold to construction companies, appliance OEMs, and distributors.

products.name: Aerosol Propellants and Cleaning Solvents
products.description: Produces aerosol propellants and high-performance cleaning solvents, including vapor degreasing and precision cleaning agents, using advanced fluorinated chemistries. Sold to industrial, healthcare, and consumer product manufacturers.

products.name: Nuclear Conversion Services (Uranium Hexafluoride)
products.description: Provides uranium hexafluoride conversion and related services for nuclear power utilities, operating the only U.S.-based facility for this process. Services are delivered through a joint venture and involve regulated, large-scale chemical processing.

products.name: Healthcare and Pharmaceutical Packaging Materials
products.description: Manufactures high-barrier, clear specialty polymers and films for medical and pharmaceutical packaging, including blister packs and metered-dose inhalers. Produced using proprietary fluorinated chemistries and sold to healthcare packaging producers globally.

products.name: Electronic Materials for Semiconductors
products.description: Produces advanced electronic materials such as sputtering targets (copper manganese, titanium), electronic polymers, thermal solutions, and high-purity etchants and solvents for semiconductor manufacturing. Manufactured using proprietary extrusion and chemical processes and sold to leading-edge semiconductor fabricators.

products.name: High-Strength Specialty Fibers (UHMWPE)
products.description: Manufactures ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene (UHMWPE) fibers, primarily under the Spectra brand, for use in military, law enforcement, industrial, and medical applications. Produced via proprietary gel-spinning processes and sold to armor and equipment manufacturers.

products.name: Laboratory Life Science and Research Chemicals
products.description: Produces and supplies high-purity research chemicals, reagents (e.g., Hydranal for Karl Fischer titration), solvents, and specialty additives for laboratory, pharmaceutical, and industrial applications. Manufactured at scale and distributed under brands like Fluka and Hydranal.

products.name: Fine Chemicals and Specialty Additives
products.description: Manufactures fine chemicals (inorganic halides, phosphorus and sulfur derivatives, oxides) and specialty additives (plastic and wax blends) for use in pharmaceuticals, energy, coatings, adhesives, and battery manufacturing. Produced via advanced chemical synthesis and supplied to industrial customers.

products.name: Automotive Digital Marketplace
products.description: A digital platform connecting car shoppers with a nationwide network of certified dealers, enabling consumers to research, compare, and purchase new and used vehicles online or via mobile applications. The platform aggregates inventory, pricing data, and proprietary analytics to facilitate efficient car buying.

products.name: Affinity Partner Auto Buying Programs
products.description: White-labeled and co-branded car-buying websites and programs operated in partnership with over 250 brands and organizations, providing their members with a personalized digital car shopping experience and exclusive OEM incentives.

products.name: Dealer Listings and Lead Generation Services
products.description: Subscription and performance-based services for dealers to list new and used vehicle inventory on TrueCar and partner sites, generating leads from in-market car shoppers and providing tools to convert leads into sales.

products.name: Digital Retailing and Online Car Purchase (TrueCar+)
products.description: A fully digital retailing solution enabling consumers to complete the entire car-buying process online, including vehicle selection, financing, trade-in, and contract execution, with integrated dealer and lender systems.

products.name: Trade-In and Sell Your Car Solutions
products.description: Online tools for consumers to appraise, receive conditional offers, and sell or trade-in their vehicles, with TrueCar Wholesale Solutions providing guaranteed offers and facilitating dealer vehicle sourcing.

products.name: Dealer Digital Marketing Solutions (TrueCar Marketing Solutions)
products.description: A suite of digital marketing and advertising services for dealers, including on- and off-platform advertising, sponsored listings, and targeted campaigns leveraging proprietary data to drive vehicle sales and service business.

products.name: OEM Targeted Incentive and Marketing Programs
products.description: Services enabling automotive manufacturers to deliver targeted cash incentives and digital advertising to specific consumer segments, including affinity group members, with tracking and reporting for redeemed offers.

products.name: Automotive Data and Analytics Tools
products.description: Proprietary data-driven tools and content for consumers and dealers, including vehicle pricing, market insights, rankings, and reporting, delivered via the TrueCar platform and Dealer Portal to inform purchasing and sales strategies.

products.name: Finance and Insurance Referral Services
products.description: Integrated tools and partnerships that allow consumers to connect with third-party providers for auto loans, insurance, and credit score access as part of the car-buying process.

products.name: Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD) and Chemical Vapor Infiltration (CVI) Equipment
products.description: Designs, develops, and manufactures equipment for chemical vapor deposition and infiltration processes, used to coat or grow materials on substrates for aerospace, semiconductor, battery, and industrial applications. These are complex, physical manufacturing systems delivered to customer sites.

products.name: Physical Vapor Transport (PVT) Crystal Growth Systems
products.description: Manufactures PVT systems for the growth of silicon carbide (SiC) and other wide band gap crystals, used in power electronics, EVs, and semiconductor research. These are high-temperature, precision-controlled manufacturing tools delivered to customers.

products.name: Ultra-High Purity Gas and Chemical Delivery Control Systems
products.description: Designs and manufactures gas and chemical delivery systems, including storage cabinets and valve manifold boxes, for semiconductor fabrication and other high-purity applications. These are engineered hardware systems sold as standalone products or integrated into process equipment.

products.name: Nanomaterial Production Systems (Carbon Nanotubes, Graphene, Silicon Nanowires)
products.description: Provides equipment for the production and R&D of nanomaterials such as carbon nanotubes, graphene, and silicon nanowires, used in battery materials and advanced electronics. These are specialized CVD systems for material synthesis.

products.name: Thermal Process and Annealing Furnaces (including RTP and LPCVD)
products.description: Manufactures rapid thermal processing (RTP), annealing, diffusion, and low-pressure CVD furnaces for semiconductor and material processing. These are physical manufacturing tools for heating and treating materials under controlled conditions.

products.name: Custom Quartzware and Consumables
products.description: Produces standard and custom fabricated quartzware components and consumables for use in process equipment and as replacement parts for customer tools. These are precision-manufactured physical components.

products.name: Direct Write Printed Electronics (MesoScribe)
products.description: Provided direct write printed electronics products and services, including heaters, antennas, and sensors, using proprietary MesoPlasma™ printing for aerospace and industrial markets. This was a specialized manufacturing service and product line, now discontinued.

products.name: Public Sector Enterprise Software Solutions
products.description: Comprehensive, cloud-native SaaS platforms that automate and digitize core government functions for state, county, and local public sector entities. Delivered as software installations and managed in AWS and Azure environments, these solutions require ongoing development, integration, and support.

products.name: Integrated Payment Processing Solutions
products.description: Proprietary payment facilitator platform integrated into enterprise software, enabling public sector customers to process ACH, card, and digital wallet payments (including EMV, Paypal, Venmo) for court, tax, registration, utility, school, and other government-related transactions. Delivered via unified APIs and compliant with PCI and payment network standards.

products.name: JusticeTech Solutions
products.description: Cloud-based software suite for courts and public safety agencies, including digital court management, e-filing, revenue cycle management for courts, computer-aided dispatch, records and evidence management, jail management, and mobile/livescan solutions. Delivered as SaaS and tailored for justice system workflows.

products.name: Utility Management Software
products.description: Digital customer engagement platforms and billing/back-office management software for utilities, providing web, mobile, chat, and voice interfaces, self-service options, and enterprise application enhancements. Delivered as cloud-native SaaS to improve efficiency and customer experience for utility operations.

products.name: Public Administration Software
products.description: Suite of cloud-based applications for government fund accounting, digital land records (with AI indexing), mass appraisal, licensing and permitting automation, and tax/revenue collection management. Delivered as SaaS to automate and streamline administrative government functions.

products.name: Education Administration Solutions
products.description: Comprehensive software for K-12 schools, including meal account management, point of sale, menu planning, nutritional analysis, food inventory, free/reduced meal applications, and school event ticketing/concessions. Delivered as SaaS to streamline school operations and payments.

products.name: Transportation Management Software
products.description: Cloud-based software for departments of transportation, including vehicle title and registration, driver's license and permit management, and motor carrier compliance. Delivered as SaaS to automate and digitize transportation-related government services.

products.name: Broadband Internet Services
products.description: High-speed internet access delivered over fiber-rich fixed broadband networks using technologies such as DOCSIS 3.1, XGSPON, and FTTH. Offered to residential and business customers with multiple speed tiers and managed through digital platforms and customer premises equipment.

products.name: Mobile Services
products.description: Mobile voice, messaging, and data services provided as both a mobile network operator (MNO) and mobile virtual network operator (MVNO), including postpaid and prepaid plans, device sales, and value-added features. Delivered via owned and leased mobile networks, including 4G and 5G coverage.

products.name: Video Services
products.description: Digital video programming and audio services, including basic and premium channel packages, video-on-demand (VoD), cloud-based entertainment platforms (Horizon 5), and IP-only streaming devices. Delivered via set-top boxes, apps, and bundled with other services.

products.name: Fixed-Line Telephony Services
products.description: Voice services provided primarily via voice-over-internet-protocol (VoIP) technology and, in some markets, traditional circuit-switched telephony. Offered as standalone or bundled with other services, with various calling plans and value-added features.

products.name: Business Telecommunications Services
products.description: Comprehensive telecommunications solutions for business and public sector organizations, including fixed internet access, IP VPNs, cloud collaboration, unified communications, managed WiFi, business video, and value-added services such as managed security and cloud-enabled applications. Delivered via customized agreements and scalable platforms.

products.name: Wholesale Network Access Services
products.description: Provision of wholesale access to fixed and mobile network infrastructure for other operators, including broadband, video, and telephony services. Delivered through long-term commercial agreements and regulated access requirements.

products.name: Smart Home and Security Services
products.description: Bundles of home automation, intelligent WiFi, and network security services, including device security, safe browsing, fraud prevention, and home automation features. Delivered via proprietary hardware and digital platforms.

products.name: Content and Sports Channel Distribution
products.description: Distribution of exclusive and premium content, including proprietary sports channels (e.g., Play Sports, Ziggo Sport), entertainment, and local programming. Delivered via owned channels, apps, and partnerships with content providers.

products.name: Specialized Business Services (Liberty Blume)
products.description: Tech-enabled business solutions including back-office, procurement, payments, specialty finance, and people services for subsidiaries, joint ventures, and third-party customers. Delivered through dedicated teams and digital platforms.

products.name: Fixed Indexed Annuities (FIAs)
products.description: FIAs are deferred annuity contracts that allow contract owners to earn returns linked to the performance of a specified market index, such as the S&P 500, while providing principal protection. These products are manufactured and issued by F&G's insurance subsidiaries and distributed through independent agents, banks, and broker-dealers.

products.name: Fixed Rate Annuities (including Multi-Year Guaranteed Annuities - MYGAs)
products.description: Fixed rate annuities are single deposit contracts that provide a guaranteed interest rate for a specified period, including annual reset and multi-year guarantee annuities (MYGAs). These are manufactured and issued by F&G and distributed through multiple retail channels.

products.name: Registered Index-Linked Annuities (RILAs)
products.description: RILAs are deferred annuity contracts that offer policyholders the opportunity for tax-deferred growth based on the performance of a market index, with both upside potential and downside risk, and are regulated as securities. F&G entered the RILA market in early 2024.

products.name: Pension Risk Transfer (PRT) Solutions
products.description: PRT solutions involve F&G assuming pension obligations from defined-benefit plan sponsors, typically through group annuity contracts, providing guaranteed lifetime income to plan participants. These are supported by a dedicated team and distributed via brokers and institutional consultants.

products.name: Indexed Universal Life (IUL) Insurance
products.description: IUL insurance policies provide life insurance protection with a cash value component that earns interest based on the performance of a market index. F&G targets the underserved middle market and distributes these products primarily through Network Marketing Groups (NMGs) and independent agents.

products.name: Funding Agreements (including Funding Agreement-Backed Notes - FABN)
products.description: Funding agreements are contracts where F&G accepts and accumulates funds and makes future payments not based on mortality or morbidity, often used by institutional clients for spread lending. These include collateralized agreements with the Federal Home Loan Bank and marketable notes (FABN) issued via capital markets.

products.name: Single Premium Immediate Annuities (SPIA)
products.description: SPIAs are contracts that provide a series of periodic payments for a fixed period or for the life of the policyholder, beginning within one annuity period after purchase. F&G has previously sold these products, primarily to retirees seeking steady income.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides term loans and lines of credit to small and midsized businesses for capital equipment, working capital, and operational purposes, including specialized loans for agricultural equipment and production. These loans are originated and serviced through physical branch offices and personal relationship management.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Offers loans for owner occupied and non-owner occupied commercial properties, including offices, warehouses, hotels, retail centers, multifamily properties, skilled nursing, assisted living facilities, and farmland. Loans are originated and managed through in-person banking channels and require collateral and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Construction and Land Development Lending
products.description: Provides loans to businesses and developers for the construction of commercial and residential properties, as well as to individuals for single family home construction. Loans are disbursed as construction progresses and are managed through local branches with regulatory oversight.

products.name: Residential Real Estate Lending
products.description: Offers first and second mortgage loans and home equity lines of credit to individuals, primarily for the purchase or improvement of primary residences. These are originated through branch offices and require collateral and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Consumer Installment Lending
products.description: Provides installment loans to consumers for the purchase of automobiles, boats, recreational vehicles, major appliances, and home improvement projects. Loans are originated through branches and partnerships with retailers and vendors, and serviced in compliance with consumer lending regulations.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Offers traditional depository products such as checking, savings, money market, and certificates of deposit to individuals, businesses, and municipalities. Services are delivered through physical branches and digital channels, with FDIC insurance and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Wealth Management and Trust Services
products.description: Provides a suite of wealth management services including trust administration, investment management, financial and estate planning, trustee and custodial services, tax and insurance planning, business planning, corporate retirement plan consulting, and retail brokerage. Services are delivered by specialized personnel and through third-party broker dealers, requiring regulatory registration and oversight.

products.name: Merchant Credit Card Services
products.description: Provides merchant credit card processing services to business customers, enabling them to accept card payments. Services are delivered through the bank’s infrastructure and require compliance with payment processing regulations.

products.name: Insurance and Financial Planning Services
products.description: Offers insurance and financial planning services to individuals and businesses, including risk management and advisory solutions. Services are delivered by licensed professionals and may involve partnerships with third-party providers.

products.name: Nicotine Vaping Hardware Products (E-Cigarettes)
products.description: Manufactured and sold globally (excluding the U.S., PRC, and Russia), these products include both open and closed system e-cigarette devices, cartridges, batteries, and related components, marketed under brands such as Aspire and through OEM/ODM arrangements. Production involves physical manufacturing, assembly, and distribution via a global network of distributors.

products.name: Cannabis Vaping Hardware Products
products.description: Hardware-only vaporizer devices and components (cartridges, atomizers, batteries) designed for cannabis or hemp oil, sold primarily on an ODM basis to cannabis brands in the U.S., Canada, South Africa, and expanding globally. Products are manufactured using proprietary technologies and do not include cannabis or hemp oil; customers fill the hardware with their own oils.

products.name: OEM and ODM Vaping Hardware Manufacturing Services
products.description: Design, customization, and manufacturing of vaping hardware (both nicotine and cannabis) for third-party brands, including both original equipment manufacturing (OEM) and original design manufacturing (ODM). Services include product design, customization, and assembly, leveraging proprietary technologies and manufacturing facilities.

products.name: Vaping Technology Licensing (Age-Gating and Safety Technologies)
products.description: Licensing of proprietary vaping-related technologies, such as point-of-use age-gating, anti-leakage, and safety features, to third parties and joint ventures. These digital and hardware solutions are developed in-house and through joint ventures, and are intended to enhance regulatory compliance and consumer safety.

products.name: Paperboard Packaging Solutions
products.description: Designs and manufactures paperboard cartons, multipack cartons, trays, carriers, canisters, cups, bowls, and containers primarily from recycled, unbleached, or bleached paperboard. These are produced at manufacturing and packaging facilities, then converted (printed, cut, folded, glued) to customer specifications for food, beverage, foodservice, household, health, and beauty markets.

products.name: Foodservice Packaging
products.description: Produces and supplies cups, lids, trays, and food containers made primarily from paperboard for quick-service restaurants and other foodservice providers. These products are manufactured and converted at specialized facilities and delivered to foodservice customers.

products.name: Packaging Machinery and Systems
products.description: Designs, manufactures, installs, and services proprietary packaging machines that automate the packaging of bottles, cans, and some non-beverage consumer products. These machines are installed at customer plants and supported with service and performance monitoring.

products.name: Open Market Paperboard Sales
products.description: Sells various grades of bleached, unbleached, and recycled paperboard to independent and integrated paperboard packaging producers. Paperboard is produced at company facilities and sold as a raw material to external customers.

products.name: Oral Film Pharmaceutical Products (PharmFilm®)
products.description: Proprietary and licensed pharmaceutical products delivered via oral film technology, manufactured at company facilities and supplied to licensees for global distribution. These products are designed to provide alternatives to traditional dosage forms and are produced using proprietary polymer compositions and manufacturing techniques.

products.name: Anaphylm™ (Sublingual Epinephrine Film)
products.description: A proprietary, non-device-based, orally delivered sublingual film formulation of an epinephrine prodrug for the emergency treatment of severe allergic reactions, including anaphylaxis. Manufactured using proprietary PharmFilm technology and pending regulatory approval.

products.name: AdrenaVerse™ Epinephrine Prodrug Platform
products.description: A platform technology generating a pipeline of differentiated epinephrine prodrug product candidates for various delivery forms (oral, topical, etc.), enabling local or systemic delivery for multiple disease indications. Products are developed using proprietary prodrug chemistry and delivery technologies.

products.name: AQST-108 (Topical Epinephrine Gel)
products.description: A topically delivered adrenergic agonist prodrug (dipivefrin) gel, developed for potential treatment of alopecia areata. Manufactured using proprietary prodrug and formulation technology, currently in clinical development.

products.name: Libervant® (Diazepam Buccal Film)
products.description: A buccally administered soluble film formulation of diazepam for the acute treatment of seizure clusters in epilepsy patients. Manufactured using PharmFilm technology and supplied to licensees for commercialization in various territories.

products.name: Suboxone® (Buprenorphine/Naloxone Sublingual Film)
products.description: A sublingual film formulation of buprenorphine and naloxone for the treatment of opioid dependence, manufactured exclusively by the company and supplied to licensees for global distribution.

products.name: Emylif® / Exservan (Riluzole Oral Film)
products.description: An oral film formulation of riluzole for the treatment of ALS, developed and manufactured by the company and licensed to partners for commercialization in select territories.

products.name: Ondif® / Zuplenz (Ondansetron Oral Film)
products.description: An oral soluble film formulation of ondansetron for the treatment of nausea and vomiting associated with chemotherapy and post-operative recovery, manufactured by the company and supplied to licensees for commercialization in select markets.

products.name: Sympazan® (Clobazam Oral Film)
products.description: An oral soluble film formulation of clobazam for the treatment of seizures associated with Lennox-Gastaut syndrome, manufactured by the company and supplied to licensees for commercialization.

products.name: KYNMOBI® (Apomorphine Sublingual Film)
products.description: A sublingual film formulation of apomorphine for the treatment of episodic off-periods in Parkinson’s disease, developed using company technology and licensed to partners for commercialization.

products.name: Azstarys® (Serdexmethylphenidate/d-MPH Oral Product)
products.description: An FDA-approved, once-daily oral product for the treatment of ADHD, for which the company receives milestone and royalty revenues based on a prior collaboration and license agreement.

products.name: Credit Card Lending
products.description: Issuance and servicing of consumer and small business credit cards, including international card businesses in the U.K. and Canada. Delivered through digital channels, branches, and partner networks; requires significant financial capital, regulatory compliance, and technology infrastructure.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Provision of consumer loans such as auto loans and personal loans, delivered through digital channels and branch locations. Involves underwriting, regulatory compliance, and capital management.

products.name: Deposit and Banking Services
products.description: Offering depository accounts and related banking services to consumers and small businesses, including checking, savings, and debit cards. Delivered via digital platforms, branches, cafés, and ATMs; requires regulated infrastructure and compliance.

products.name: Commercial Lending and Banking Services
products.description: Provision of loans, deposit accounts, capital markets, and treasury management services to commercial real estate and commercial and industrial clients. Requires financial capital, in-person relationship management, and regulatory oversight.

products.name: Global Payment Network Services
products.description: Operation of global payment networks (Discover Network, PULSE Network, Diners Club International) providing transaction processing, settlement, and card acceptance services to merchants, acquirers, issuers, and network partners. Delivered via regulated, technology-driven infrastructure.

products.name: Broker-Dealer and Capital Markets Services
products.description: Provision of securities brokerage, investment banking, and related capital markets services through registered broker-dealer subsidiaries. Requires regulatory compliance, financial expertise, and technology systems.

products.name: Natural Gas Distribution Services
products.description: Distribution of natural gas to residential, commercial, and transportation customers through a regulated utility infrastructure. This involves physical delivery via pipelines, metering, and regulated rate structures across Oklahoma, Kansas, and Texas.

products.name: Natural Gas Transportation Services
products.description: Transportation of customer-owned natural gas for large industrial and commercial customers, who purchase their own supply and pay a fee for delivery through the company's pipeline network. This service is provided under regulated tariffs and negotiated rates.

firms.firm: HUNT J B TRANSPORT SERVICES INC

products.name: Intermodal Freight Transportation
products.description: Combines rail and truck services to transport full-truckload containerized freight across North America, utilizing company-owned containers, chassis, and tractors, as well as partnerships with major rail carriers. Pickup and delivery (drayage) are performed by company drivers or third-party dray carriers.

products.name: Dedicated Contract Transportation Services
products.description: Provides long-term, customized transportation solutions including private fleet conversion, specialized equipment, labor, and network design, typically under multi-year contracts. Services are tailored to customer requirements and may include multiple pickups, drops, and specialized handling.

products.name: Freight Brokerage and Logistics Services
products.description: Offers freight brokerage and logistics management by matching shippers with third-party carriers for a variety of freight types (dry-van, flatbed, refrigerated, LTL, intermodal), leveraging a digital platform (J.B. Hunt 360) and providing single-source logistics outsourcing and supply chain technology.

products.name: Last-Mile Delivery and Installation Services
products.description: Delivers big and bulky items to homes and businesses, including installation, fulfillment, and retail-pooling distribution, using a network of cross-dock and delivery locations and both company and third-party assets.

products.name: Over-the-Road Truckload Freight Services
products.description: Transports full-load, dry-van freight over highways using company-owned and independent contractor tractors and trailers, including drop trailer solutions via the J.B. Hunt 360box program.

products.name: Electric Utility Services
products.description: Provision of regulated electric generation, distribution, and retail and wholesale electricity sales to residential, commercial, industrial, and municipal customers in Iowa, Wisconsin, and Illinois. Electricity is produced using a mix of owned electric generating units (coal, natural gas, wind, solar, hydro) and purchased power agreements, delivered via regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Natural Gas Utility Services
products.description: Provision of regulated natural gas distribution and transportation services to residential, commercial, and industrial customers in Iowa and Wisconsin. Services include delivery of company-supplied and customer-owned gas through regulated pipeline and storage infrastructure.

products.name: Freight and Supply Chain Solutions
products.description: Provision of freight transportation and logistics services, including short-line rail freight, barge, rail and truck terminal operations, freight brokerage, and rail-served warehousing, primarily in Iowa and Illinois. Services are delivered through owned and operated physical infrastructure and logistics management.

products.name: Development-Ready Industrial Sites
products.description: Offering of rail-served and ready-to-build manufacturing and industrial sites with access to transportation infrastructure (airports, interstate freeways) within Alliant Energy’s service territories. Sites are prepared and marketed for sale or lease to external industrial customers.

products.name: MYQORZO (aficamten)
products.description: A novel, oral, small molecule cardiac myosin inhibitor manufactured via chemical synthesis and distributed as tablets. It is approved and commercialized for the treatment of symptomatic obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (oHCM) in adults, with ongoing development for additional indications and geographies. Delivered through prescription and supported by a specialty sales force and patient support programs.

products.name: Aficamten-based Therapies (future indications)
products.description: Pipeline small molecule therapies based on aficamten, developed for additional indications such as non-obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (nHCM) and pediatric oHCM. These are produced via chemical synthesis and delivered as oral tablets, pending regulatory approval in new indications and geographies.

products.name: Omecamtiv Mecarbil
products.description: A late-stage, selective, small molecule cardiac myosin activator developed for the treatment of heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF). Manufactured via chemical synthesis, it is intended for both hospital and outpatient use, pending regulatory approval.

products.name: Ulacamten
products.description: A novel, selective, oral, small molecule cardiac myosin inhibitor in clinical development for the treatment of heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF) and related conditions. Manufactured via chemical synthesis and delivered as oral tablets, it is currently in Phase 2 trials.

products.name: CK-089 (Skeletal Muscle Activator)
products.description: An investigational, orally administered, small molecule fast skeletal muscle troponin activator developed for the treatment of specific types of muscular dystrophy and other neuromuscular conditions. Manufactured via chemical synthesis, currently in Phase 1 clinical trials.

products.name: Networked Charging Systems (AC and DC)
products.description: ChargePoint designs, manufactures (via contract partners), and sells a range of Level 2 AC and Level 3 DC fast charging stations for commercial, fleet, and residential use. These hardware products are physically installed at customer sites and support all major EV types and charging scenarios.

products.name: ChargePoint Platform (Charger Management Software and eMSP Service)
products.description: A cloud-based SaaS platform combining charger management (CMS) and e-Mobility Service Provider (eMSP) services, enabling customers to manage charging infrastructure, driver access, billing, energy optimization, and integration with third-party hardware and applications. Delivered digitally via subscriptions and APIs.

products.name: Mobile and In-Vehicle Applications for EV Drivers
products.description: ChargePoint provides a mobile app and in-vehicle integrations that allow EV drivers to locate, access, and pay for charging at ChargePoint and partner stations, manage home charging, and receive real-time notifications. Delivered as digital software to end users.

products.name: Third-Party Charging Station Enablement (ChargePoint Compatible)
products.description: ChargePoint sells CMS subscriptions and activation services to enable third-party manufactured charging stations to be managed and operated on the ChargePoint Platform, expanding its ecosystem beyond proprietary hardware. Delivered via software and service activation.

products.name: Professional Services (Site Planning, Activation, Commissioning, Grant Support)
products.description: ChargePoint provides professional services including on-site development, analysis, activation, commissioning, and support for rebate or grant applications to ensure safe, compliant, and optimized deployment of charging infrastructure. Delivered through in-person and remote expert labor.

products.name: Assure and Assure Pro Warranty and Support Services
products.description: ChargePoint sells extended parts and labor warranties, proactive monitoring, technical support, and maintenance services (including Assure and Assure Pro) to maximize charging station uptime and reliability. Delivered as a subscription and through a network of certified field partners.

products.name: Aerospace Systems and Components
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and supplies advanced aerospace systems and components such as electric power systems, flight control systems, engine components, landing gear, avionics, propeller systems, and cabin interiors for commercial and military aircraft. These products require complex physical manufacturing and are delivered to aircraft manufacturers and operators worldwide.

products.name: Aircraft Engines and Propulsion Systems
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and services large and small aircraft engines for commercial, military, business jet, general aviation, and helicopters, including auxiliary power units and hybrid-electric propulsion systems. These products involve advanced engineering, regulated manufacturing, and global service networks.

products.name: Aerospace and Defense Aftermarket Services
products.description: Provides aftermarket services including spare parts, overhaul and repair, engineering and technical support, training, fleet management, asset management, and information management for civil and military aircraft. These services are delivered through global facilities and require technical expertise and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Integrated Air and Missile Defense Systems
products.description: Designs, develops, and delivers integrated air and missile defense systems, including radars, interceptors, and command and control solutions for land, air, and sea applications. These systems are physically manufactured, technologically advanced, and sold primarily to government and military customers.

products.name: Missiles and Smart Weapons
products.description: Develops and manufactures a broad portfolio of offensive and defensive missiles, smart weapons, and munitions for air, land, and sea platforms. These products are physically produced, technologically sophisticated, and primarily sold to government and military customers.

products.name: Space-Based Systems and Solutions
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and delivers space-based systems including satellites, space-qualified sensors, satellite control, and mission orchestration software for government and commercial customers. These offerings require advanced engineering, regulated manufacturing, and digital integration.

products.name: Connected Aviation and Air Traffic Management Solutions
products.description: Provides digital and physical solutions for connected aviation, including voice and data communication networks, airport systems integration, and air traffic management systems. These offerings combine digital infrastructure with physical equipment and are delivered to airlines, airports, and government agencies.

products.name: Simulation, Training, and Test Systems
products.description: Develops and provides simulation, training, and test systems for aerospace and defense applications, including crew escape systems, test and training range systems, and simulation platforms. These products and services are delivered through a combination of physical systems and digital platforms to government and commercial customers.

products.name: Aerospace and Defense Components and Systems
products.description: Specialty filtration, fluid control devices, precision-tolerance machined components, miniature electro-explosive devices, and naval products including magnetic signature management and power control systems, manufactured for aviation, Navy, and defense applications through advanced engineering and physical manufacturing.

products.name: Diagnostic Testing and Data Management Solutions for Electric Utilities
products.description: Diagnostic test instruments, condition monitoring systems, dissolved gas analysis, oil testing, data management solutions, and expert consulting services for electric power grid operators and utilities, delivered through a combination of electronic instrumentation manufacturing, software, and consulting.

products.name: Renewable Energy Decision Support Tools
products.description: Design and manufacture of decision support tools, including hardware and software, for the renewable energy industry, primarily wind and solar, produced through specialized engineering and manufacturing processes.

products.name: RF Test and Measurement Products and Systems
products.description: Design and manufacture of products and turnkey systems to measure and control radio frequency (RF) energy, including RF test facilities, measurement systems, shielded rooms, and secure communication facilities, serving research, regulatory, medical, and security applications through advanced engineering and physical manufacturing.

products.name: RF and Electromagnetic Shielding Components
products.description: Manufacture and supply of RF absorptive materials, filters, antennas, field probes, test cells, and electromagnetic protection filters for use in test, military, utility, and critical infrastructure applications, produced through specialized materials engineering and manufacturing.

products.name: Calibration and Product Testing Services
products.description: Provision of calibration and accredited product testing services for RF and electromagnetic compatibility, delivered through in-person human labor and specialized laboratory infrastructure.

products.name: Syntactic Materials for Buoyancy and Specialty Applications
products.description: Design and manufacture of custom syntactic foam components and systems for industrial, oceanographic, military, and naval applications, produced through advanced materials engineering and manufacturing.

products.name: Corporate Debt Investments
products.description: Provision of capital to corporate borrowers primarily through investments in senior secured loans and, to a lesser extent, subordinated and unsecured debt. These investments are typically made in cash-flow positive companies and are structured as fixed or variable rate notes, often requiring in-depth credit analysis and ongoing monitoring. Delivery involves direct lending and participation in syndicated loans.

products.name: Collateralized Loan Obligation (CLO) Investments
products.description: Investment in equity and junior debt tranches of CLO vehicles, which are structured finance entities that acquire diversified pools of senior secured corporate loans. OXSQ invests in both primary and secondary CLO markets, including warehouse facilities that aggregate loans prior to CLO formation. These are highly leveraged, structured financial products requiring specialized analysis and are delivered through capital markets transactions.

products.name: Publicly Traded Debt and Equity Securities Investments
products.description: Selective investment in publicly traded debt and equity securities, providing additional portfolio diversification. These investments are made through purchases in public markets and are not the primary focus but supplement the main investment strategy.

products.name: Specialty Commercial Insurance
products.description: A broad array of specialty commercial insurance products including general liability, excess liability, professional liability (including cyber and media), commercial auto, group accident and health, property, agriculture, credit, surety, and workers’ compensation. These products are delivered on both admitted and non-admitted (E&S) bases, requiring specialized underwriting and claims management, and are distributed through retail agents, wholesale brokers, program administrators, and captive managers.

products.name: Medical Stop-Loss Insurance and Captive Solutions
products.description: Medical stop-loss insurance for employers who self-insure their employee benefits, including tailored solutions for group and single-employer captives. Delivered through dedicated underwriting and proactive claims oversight, primarily distributed via brokers and captive managers.

products.name: Agriculture, Dairy, and Livestock Insurance and Reinsurance
products.description: Specialty risk-transfer solutions for agriculture, dairy, and livestock, including revenue protection, weather and natural peril coverage, and commodity price risk mitigation. Delivered via insurance and reinsurance structures, using derivatives to manage price volatility, and distributed globally to insurers, MGAs, and producers.

products.name: Credit and Mortgage Insurance and Reinsurance
products.description: Insurance and reinsurance products covering credit risk (single obligor and multi-buyer trade credit) and mortgage default risk, structured to manage tail risk and loss severity for government-sponsored entities and private mortgage insurers. Delivered through treaty protection and proportional/excess of loss structures.

products.name: Construction and Energy Insurance Solutions
products.description: Tailored, often multi-line insurance solutions for construction and energy sector clients, including general liability, excess liability, commercial auto, and workers’ compensation. Delivered through experienced underwriting and claims teams, distributed via retail agents, brokers, and wholesalers.

products.name: Global Property Insurance and Reinsurance
products.description: Comprehensive property insurance and reinsurance solutions for commercial clients worldwide, protecting against physical loss or damage to assets from natural catastrophes and other perils. Delivered through direct insurance and reinsurance, supported by catastrophe modeling and risk management.

products.name: Professional and Management Liability Insurance
products.description: Primary and excess claims-made liability products including management liability, professional liability (such as cyber and media), and allied health (including life sciences). Delivered on both E&S and admitted bases, distributed through wholesale and retail brokers.

products.name: Specialty Program Insurance
products.description: Insurance products delivered through partnerships with program administrators who possess scale or proprietary technology in specific market niches. Covers property, general liability, commercial auto liability, excess liability, and workers’ compensation, on both E&S and admitted bases.

products.name: Surety Bonds
products.description: Contract, commercial, and transactional surety solutions for trade and services organizations, focusing on small to medium sized enterprises. Delivered on an admitted basis and distributed through retail agents and brokers.

products.name: Transactional Excess & Surplus (E&S) Insurance
products.description: Primary and excess property and general liability insurance for hard-to-place risks, such as those with complex exposures, loss history, or limited operating history. Delivered exclusively through wholesale brokers, focusing on non-catastrophe prone risks.

products.name: Specialty Reinsurance
products.description: Reinsurance solutions, principally for property, agriculture, and credit risks, focused on specialty classes where reinsurance is more efficient due to cost or geographic expansion. Delivered via treaty and facultative reinsurance structures to insurers and risk originators.

products.name: Lloyd’s Syndicate Specialty Insurance (Apollo)
products.description: Multi-class specialty insurance underwritten through Lloyd’s Syndicates 1969 and 1971, including innovative liability products for the digital and sharing economy. Delivered via a capital-light, managing agency model, with Apollo earning managing agency fees and profit commissions.

products.name: Private Equity Investment Management
products.description: Management of private equity investment vehicles, including traditional private equity, core private equity, and growth equity strategies, investing in companies for long-term capital appreciation through controlling or minority positions. Delivered via fund structures and requires significant financial capital and investment expertise.

products.name: Real Assets Investment Management
products.description: Management of investment vehicles focused on real assets, including infrastructure, real estate (equity and credit), and energy. Involves sourcing, acquiring, and managing physical assets and related securities globally, requiring specialized operational and technical expertise.

products.name: Credit and Liquid Strategies Investment Management
products.description: Management of credit-focused investment vehicles, including leveraged credit, alternative credit (asset-based finance, corporate credit, capital solutions), and hedge fund partnerships. Involves investing in corporate debt, structured products, and providing financing solutions globally.

products.name: Capital Markets Services
products.description: Provision of capital markets services such as arranging debt and equity financing, underwriting securities offerings, loan syndications, and capital markets advisory for KKR, portfolio companies, insurance business, and third-party clients. Delivered through broker-dealer operations and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Insurance and Reinsurance Solutions
products.description: Provision of retirement and life insurance products (fixed-rate, fixed-indexed, and registered index-linked annuities, preneed life) to individuals, and customized reinsurance, pension risk transfer, and funding agreement solutions to institutional clients. Requires regulated insurance operations and significant capital management.

products.name: Hedge Fund Platform Partnerships
products.description: Minority ownership and partnership with third-party hedge fund managers, offering clients access to alternative investment strategies such as long/short equity products. Delivered via strategic partnerships and co-branded vehicles.

products.name: Branded Ophthalmic Pharmaceuticals
products.description: FDA-approved ophthalmic drugs for the treatment and management of various eye diseases and conditions, including anesthetics, anti-infectives, anti-inflammatories, immunomodulators, biosimilars, and lubricants. These products are manufactured by third parties and sold primarily in the U.S. and Canada.

products.name: Compounded Ophthalmic Pharmaceuticals (ImprimisRx)
products.description: Customized, non-FDA-approved ophthalmic medications prepared in compounding facilities for eyecare professionals and patients, including combination therapies, alternative dosage strengths, and preservative-free formulations. Products are dispensed via 503A pharmacy or manufactured for in-office use in a 503B outsourcing facility.

products.name: Procedural Sedation Pharmaceuticals (MELT-300 and Pipeline)
products.description: Development and commercialization of proprietary, non-intravenous, sublingual sedation and anesthesia therapeutics (e.g., MELT-300, MELT-210) for use in ophthalmic and other outpatient procedures. These are manufactured pharmaceuticals intended to provide rapid, predictable sedation without IV administration.

products.name: Sparkling Water Beverages
products.description: Sparkling water beverages, primarily under the LaCroix brand, are produced using in-house crafted flavors and concentrates, and are distributed in various package sizes through multiple retail channels. Production is vertically integrated and packaging is designed for shelf appeal.

products.name: Juice and Juice Drinks
products.description: A range of 100% juice and juice-based beverages, including Everfresh, Everfresh Premier Varietals, and Mr. Pure, produced in hot-filled glass bottles and other packaging, with flavors from classic to exotic, distributed primarily for single-serve consumption.

products.name: Energy Drinks and Shots
products.description: Energy drinks and shots, primarily under the Rip It brand, are produced in multiple flavors and package configurations, including sugar-free options, and distributed through retail and food-service channels. Production is vertically integrated and includes both canned and bottled formats.

products.name: Non-Carbonated Flavored Water Beverages
products.description: Non-carbonated water beverages enhanced with fruit flavors, primarily under the Clear Fruit brand, produced in various bottle sizes with sports caps, and distributed through retail channels.

products.name: Carbonated Soft Drinks
products.description: Carbonated soft drinks, including iconic brands such as Shasta and Faygo, are produced in a variety of flavors and package sizes, including zero sugar options, and distributed regionally and nationally through multiple retail channels.

products.name: Modular Couches (Sactionals)
products.description: Modular couches composed of standardized seats and sides, with customizable covers and accessories, manufactured by third-party partners and sold through showrooms and ecommerce. Built for durability and adaptability, with options for add-ons like reclining seats and tables.

products.name: Oversized Foam Beanbag Chairs (Sacs)
products.description: Premium foam-filled beanbag chairs available in multiple sizes, featuring removable, washable covers and proprietary Durafoam filling. Manufactured externally and distributed via omni-channel sales.

products.name: Home Theater Sound and Charging Systems (StealthTech)
products.description: Integrated surround sound and wireless charging systems designed to be embedded within Sactionals, including speakers, subwoofers, and charging modules. Developed in partnership with Harman Kardon and sold as add-ons to core furniture products.

products.name: Premium Modular Seating (Snugg)
products.description: A platform of premium seating including sofas, loveseats, and chairs with washable fabrics, changeable covers, and customizable fill. Designed for flexibility and easy transport, manufactured by third-party partners.

products.name: Furniture Accessories and Add-ons
products.description: A range of accessories designed to enhance Sactionals and Sacs, including drink holders, blankets, pillows, fitted tables, ottomans, and power hubs. These are manufactured externally and sold as complementary products to core furniture lines.

products.name: Revitalized Open-Box Furniture (Loved by Lovesac)
products.description: Resale of quality-assured, revitalized open-box products through a dedicated online platform, with items inspected and verified for resale. Supports sustainability by extending product lifecycle.

products.name: Personal Auto Insurance
products.description: Insurance coverage for private passenger vehicles, underwritten and delivered through both agency and direct channels, utilizing proprietary pricing models and usage-based insurance technology.

products.name: Special Lines Insurance (Motorcycle, RV, Watercraft, Other Recreational Vehicles)
products.description: Insurance for motorcycles, recreational vehicles (RVs), watercraft, and other recreational vehicles, underwritten and delivered through agency and direct channels, with specialized product models and seasonal risk management.

products.name: Personal Residential Property Insurance (Homeowners, Renters, Manufactured Homes, Flood, Umbrella)
products.description: Insurance for homeowners, renters, manufactured homes, personal umbrella, and flood (including participation in the National Flood Insurance Program), delivered via agency and direct channels, with advanced risk segmentation and reinsurance for catastrophe risk.

products.name: Commercial Auto Insurance
products.description: Auto-related liability and physical damage insurance for commercial vehicles, including for-hire specialty, transportation, tow, contractor, and business auto, delivered primarily through agencies with advanced segmentation and usage-based insurance options.

products.name: Business Owners Policy (BOP) and Commercial Property Insurance
products.description: Business-related general liability and commercial property insurance, predominantly for small businesses, delivered through agents and digital quoting platforms, with risk managed via reinsurance programs.

products.name: Workers’ Compensation Insurance (Transportation Industry Focus)
products.description: Workers’ compensation insurance tailored for the transportation industry, including loss prevention services and dedicated claims handling, distributed through a limited broker network and supported by reinsurance.

products.name: Transportation Network Company (TNC) Insurance
products.description: Commercial auto coverage for transportation network companies (e.g., Uber), with premiums based on actual and estimated miles driven, delivered through direct channels and managed with quota-share reinsurance.

products.name: Insurance Agency and Brokerage Services (Affiliated and Unaffiliated Carriers)
products.description: Commission- or fee-based agency and brokerage services, acting as an agent for affiliated and unaffiliated insurance companies to offer home, condominium, renters, commercial auto, and other insurance products, with compensation via commissions or service fees.

products.name: Bundled Insurance Products
products.description: Bundled offerings combining personal auto, special lines, and personal property insurance, available through both agency and direct channels, with integrated quoting systems and discounts to incentivize multi-product relationships.

products.name: Usage-Based Insurance Programs (Snapshot®, Smart Haul®, Snapshot ProView®)
products.description: Usage-based insurance programs for personal and commercial auto customers, leveraging telematics data from mobile apps or electronic logging devices to personalize pricing and offer discounts, delivered digitally.

products.name: Practice-Building Platform for Hormone Optimization (Biote Method)
products.description: A comprehensive, end-to-end platform sold to medical practices, including education, training, certification, practice management software, inventory management software, clinical decision support software, and ongoing support, enabling practitioners to establish and operate hormone optimization programs. Delivered through in-person and virtual training, proprietary digital tools, and ongoing mentorship.

products.name: Biote-Branded Dietary Supplements
products.description: A line of private-labeled dietary supplements formulated to support hormone, vitamin, and physiological health, manufactured by third parties to Biote specifications and sold wholesale to Biote-certified practitioners and directly to consumers via eCommerce. Distribution is managed through third-party logistics partners.

products.name: Sterile Pellet Insertion Kits
products.description: Sterile convenience kits containing disposable medical supplies (e.g., gloves, antiseptic, gauze, disposable trocar) for use by practitioners in hormone pellet insertion procedures. Kits are assembled and supplied by a third-party partner and sold to clinics.

products.name: AI-Driven Digital Human Creation and Customization
products.description: Development and delivery of AI-powered digital human avatars, which are created and customized using proprietary artificial intelligence technologies. These digital humans are used for interactive applications and are delivered as digital products or services, requiring advanced software development and AI expertise.

products.name: Live Streaming and E-Commerce Services
products.description: Provision of live streaming platforms and related e-commerce services, enabling real-time digital content delivery and online sales. This business line leverages digital infrastructure and human labor to facilitate interactive commerce and entertainment experiences.

products.name: Interactive Reading and Narrative Entertainment Platform
products.description: Development of a digital platform that enables creators to produce interactive, game-like reading experiences for end users, utilizing AI-powered content creation tools for narrative generation, visual asset creation, and interactive dialogue systems. The platform is delivered as a digital service, with monetization through content access fees and in-app purchases.

products.name: Digital Asset Treasury Management
products.description: Holding and managing digital assets, primarily Bitcoin, as a long-term reserve for the company. This business line involves financial capital management and participation in the decentralized finance ecosystem, rather than active trading or customer-facing services.

products.name: AI-Driven Molecular Discovery Platform
products.description: A digital, AI-powered software platform (Molecule.ai) that provides molecular modeling, predictive analytics, and structured scientific workflows to accelerate early-stage drug discovery and development for pharmaceutical researchers. Delivered as a modular, API-first, cloud-based solution requiring advanced AI infrastructure and integration with scientific research environments.

products.name: Institutional Securities Services
products.description: Comprehensive investment banking, capital markets, sales and trading, and market-making services for corporations, governments, and financial institutions, delivered through regulated broker-dealer and banking subsidiaries with significant physical and digital infrastructure.

products.name: Wealth Management Services
products.description: Financial advisory, brokerage, and investment solutions for individuals and small businesses, including financial planning, margin lending, and digital investing, delivered via advisor-led, workplace, and digital direct channels, supported by regulated broker-dealer and banking entities.

products.name: Investment Management Products
products.description: Asset management services offering a range of investment products, including mutual funds, alternative investments, and private funds, for institutional and retail clients, managed by registered investment adviser subsidiaries and distributed through proprietary and third-party channels.

products.name: Lending and Loan Products
products.description: Provision of loans and lending commitments, including margin lending, commercial and residential mortgage lending, and other credit products, primarily to support investment banking and wealth management clients, delivered through regulated bank and broker-dealer subsidiaries.

products.name: Commodities and Futures Services
products.description: Trading, sales, and investment in commodities and related derivatives, including futures and physical commodities, conducted under regulatory exemptions and through registered futures commission merchants and broker-dealers.

products.name: Derivatives and Swaps Services
products.description: Origination, trading, and clearing of derivatives and swaps, including security-based swaps, for institutional and other clients, provided through registered swap dealer subsidiaries and subject to comprehensive regulatory oversight.
